explanation: CONTEXT.md sharpens the App router entry with the navigation attempt and the write policy (replace for a followed URL, push for a user action, hold for an unrecognized fragment, settings-only changes replace), the real-change rule for view-reported setters, the stable supersede() the shell calls before navigate, the rule that router-delivered intents never supersede, and the verified openInExplorer(id, track). The ui-change workflow tells a new shell control to call supersede() first.
